items.title: Tigers' tricky equation for final

items.title: Nayeem's double ton, Zawad's record-breaking fifty light up NCL
items.summary: Nayeem Ahmed struck the National Cricket League's first double century of the season, while Zawad Abrar set a new record for the fastest fifty in Bangladesh first-class cricket as batters dominated the third day of the third round on Tuesday. Azizul Hakim Tamim and Mohammad Naim also struck centuries in their respective matches.

items.title: Tigers must win big against Afghanistan and overcome NRR mountain to reach tri-series final

items.title: Can Tigers’ middle order bat smarter?
items.summary: Bangladesh failed to build on a decent start against Zimbabwe, struggling to rotate strike as pressure mounted. Hridoy tried to force the pace and fell, triggering a collapse that saw the Tigers bowled out for 172 in 33.4 overs while chasing 272.
